item.title: 001 Independent Researcher Manifesto: The Architecture of Resonance
item.description: From observation to design, this manifesto introduces the Architecture of Resonance — a framework connecting research, art, strategy, academic inquiry, sovereignty, and the capitalization of non-obvious value.

item.title: 003 Independent Researcher Manifesto: The Right to Creativity
item.description: This manifesto establishes creativity as a research method capable of generating knowledge, testing hypotheses, and designing new realities beyond the limits of analytical language.

item.title: 004 Independent Researcher Manifesto: The Right to Simplicity
item.description: Simplicity is not the absence of complexity but its highest integrated form. Any system ultimately exists to protect the fundamental conditions of life: home, childhood, peace, safety, and human dignity.

item.title: 015 Architecture of Civilizational Endurance. From Regularity to Sovereign Rhythm
item.description: From Duolingo Max to a rowing machine, this recalibration examines the transition from daily regularity to sovereign rhythm, introducing civilizational endurance as a new paradigm of Ultra Deep Work.

item.title: 📃 Independent Researcher Manifesto
item.description: This series presents the Independent Researcher Manifesto as an evolving structure. Each manifesto records a stage of development, refines the method, expands interpretation, and contributes to the RESONANCE_SYSTEM.

item.title: ✯ Extra Credit Problem (The Asterisk Problem)
item.description: A multidisciplinary research framework examining countries and regions where freedom, human dignity, child protection, and individual agency face systemic challenges. Each case study maps the path from tragedy and diagnosis to recovery, subjectivity, and civilizational renewal.
